name: arc-four-panel-priority-overlay
description: Use when an ARC grid contains four 4x4 color panels separated by delimiter columns. Merge cells by a fixed color priority.
---

# ARC four-panel priority overlay

When a 4x19 grid is laid out as four 4x4 panels with one all-3 delimiter column between panels, the output is a 4x4 overlay.

## Procedure
1. Split each row into four 4-cell panels: columns 1–4, 6–9, 11–14, and 16–19 (1-indexed); the intervening columns contain delimiter value 3.
2. For each corresponding cell position, collect the nonzero values from the four panels.
3. Choose the highest-priority present color, using this priority order: **9 > 4 > 8 > 5**. Zero means empty and is ignored.
4. Emit the selected color in the output 4x4 grid.

This rule is supported by a demonstrated pair: positions containing 9 beat other colors; 4 beats 8 and 5; 8 beats 5. If a position is empty in every panel, retain 0.

## Verification
Check that the result is exactly 4x4 and that each output cell came from one of the four corresponding input-panel cells. Delimiter 3s are structural and never output colors.",
